subject.title: fix: stabilize embedded prompt caching across policy and Responses boundaries

question: Should protected tool schemas remain model-visible on denied turns when immutable turn policy and runtime/MCP gates reject calls before hooks or side effects?
rationale: This intentionally changes the permanent security and compatibility contract from inventory omission to execution-time authorization; code review can verify the gates, but maintainer intent must approve the model-visible boundary.

options.title: Approve stable visible schemas
options.body: Keep protected schemas stable for cache reuse and rely on the reviewed immutable policy plus pre-hook runtime and MCP execution gates.

options.title: Retain hidden denied schemas
options.body: Preserve inventory-based restriction and accept prompt-cache churn across policy changes.

options.title: Narrow the branch
options.body: Land delivery and native continuation fixes while deferring protected-schema stabilization.

recommendation.title: Approve stable visible schemas
recommendation.body: Keep protected schemas stable for cache reuse and rely on the reviewed immutable policy plus pre-hook runtime and MCP execution gates.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent canonical CLI MCP authorization and revocation work makes this the strongest available owner for the overlapping security boundary.
